# UPST-MIXED-BASIS — Research-State Review

**Thesis:** `th_a642c056f30b470ba3ee` (v1 → v2) · **Alert:** `fa_277124be0fd94fcfbc78` (v1 → v2, acknowledged) · **Review:** `tr_1a9a6bd91f804d4ca8e7`
**Event source hash:** `a86e6ffcd9520f35c8dba80b439b7a8ff21eae5ba90d3afe22bd62d1173a4b45` (Q3 2024 exhibit, as_of 2024-11-07)
**Baseline source hash:** `212f471f0522e46f10d405ed96658aa5b3c211ef86a3b6fe8d2db30e55b93e13` (Q2 2024 exhibit)

## 1. Source facts (as supplied, no outside data)

| Fact ID | Period | Basis | Unit | Value |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| UPST-Q3-REV | CY2024Q3 (2024-09-30) | GAAP | USD_thousand | 162140 |
| UPST-Q3-OPLOSS | CY2024Q3 | GAAP | USD_thousand | -45152 |
| UPST-Q3-NETLOSS | CY2024Q3 | GAAP | USD_thousand | -6758 |
| UPST-Q3-DEBTGAIN | CY2024Q3 | GAAP, nonoperating | USD_thousand | 33361 |
| UPST-Q3-ADJ-NETLOSS | CY2024Q3 | non-GAAP | USD_million_rounded | -5.3 |
| UPST-Q3-CONTRIB | CY2024Q3 | non-GAAP | USD_million_rounded | 102.4 |
| UPST-Q3-ADJ-EBITDA | CY2024Q3 | non-GAAP | USD_million_rounded | 1.4 |
| UPST-Q3-PRIOR-OPLOSS | CY2023Q3 (prior-year same quarter) | GAAP | USD_thousand | -43845 |
| UPST-Q3-PRIOR-ADJ-NETLOSS | CY2023Q3 | non-GAAP | USD_million_rounded | -3.9 |
| UPST-Q2-REV | CY2024Q2 (2024-06-30) | GAAP | USD_thousand | 127630 |
| UPST-Q2-OPLOSS | CY2024Q2 | GAAP | USD_thousand | -55486 |
| UPST-Q2-NETLOSS | CY2024Q2 | GAAP | USD_thousand | -54470 |
| UPST-Q2-ADJ-NETLOSS | CY2024Q2 | non-GAAP | USD_thousand | -15282 |
| UPST-Q2-CONTRIB | CY2024Q2 | non-GAAP | USD_million_rounded | 76.1 |
| UPST-Q2-ADJ-EBITDA | CY2024Q2 | non-GAAP | USD_million_rounded | -9.3 |

## 2. Arithmetic (derived by me — not source-stated)

**Sequential (Q3 2024 vs Q2 2024):**
- GAAP revenue: +34,510 USD_thousand (+27.0%)
- GAAP operating loss: narrowed 10,334 USD_thousand (−55,486 → −45,152)
- GAAP net loss: narrowed 47,712 USD_thousand (−54,470 → −6,758)
- Non-GAAP adjusted net loss: narrowed ~9.98 USD_million (−15.282 → −5.3; **cross-unit, rounded**)
- Non-GAAP contribution profit: +26.3 USD_million (76.1 → 102.4)
- Non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA: improved ~10.7 USD_million (−9.3 → +1.4)

**Year over year (Q3 2024 vs Q3 2023, same quarter):**
- GAAP operating loss: **widened** 1,307 USD_thousand (−43,845 → −45,152)
- Non-GAAP adjusted net loss: **widened** ~1.4 USD_million (−3.9 → −5.3)

## 3. Support

Sequential direction is favorable on every supplied measure: revenue up, GAAP operating loss narrower, contribution profit up 26.3 USD_million, and adjusted EBITDA crossing from −9.3 to +1.4 USD_million. That is consistent with the thesis catalysts "business growth" and "earnings quality" on a sequential basis.

## 4. Risk / contrary evidence

- **The GAAP net-loss narrowing is not an operating result.** The 33,361 USD_thousand nonoperating gain [UPST-Q3-DEBTGAIN] is larger than the entire remaining GAAP net loss of 6,758 USD_thousand [UPST-Q3-NETLOSS]. The 47,712 USD_thousand sequential net-loss improvement therefore cannot be read as operating progress.
- **Year over year, both operating measures worsened.** GAAP operating loss widened 1,307 USD_thousand and non-GAAP adjusted net loss widened ~1.4 USD_million. The sequential improvement does **not** resolve this contrary evidence — a positive change in one measure does not offset a negative change in another.
- Adjusted EBITDA of +1.4 USD_million is a thin margin against 162,140 USD_thousand of revenue; the packet gives no reconciliation to judge its composition.

## 5. Missing evidence

- No Q2 2023 comparatives, so the Q2 2024 baseline cannot be placed on a year-over-year footing.
- No GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation lines (adjusted net loss, contribution profit, adjusted EBITDA).
- No operating expense, margin, or segment detail; no cash flow or balance-sheet items.
- `source_claims` is empty — the packet states no causal drivers. Causal attribution for net income is recorded as **unresolved** with no driver fact IDs; I did not substitute the observed debt gain as its own cause.

## 6. Decision

**maintain** · impact **mixed** · status **active** · conviction **3** (unchanged) · next review 2026-11-06. The packet supports neither an upgrade nor an invalidation of the thesis. No trade is implied or recommended.

## 7. Research implication, counterpoint, and what would change the assessment

- **Implication (source-grounded):** The sequential operating trajectory improved while the year-over-year operating trajectory deteriorated — the two comparisons point in opposite directions on the same GAAP operating-loss line [UPST-Q3-OPLOSS vs UPST-Q2-OPLOSS vs UPST-Q3-PRIOR-OPLOSS]. Any assessment must hold both.
- **Strongest counterpoint / unresolved input:** The GAAP net-loss improvement is dominated by a nonoperating item [UPST-Q3-DEBTGAIN], and the packet supplies no reconciliation showing whether the non-GAAP adjusted net loss widening is driven by recurring costs or by definitional adjustments.
- **What would change the assessment:** A GAAP-to-non-GAAP reconciliation and operating-expense detail for Q3 2024 and Q3 2023, plus Q2 2023 comparatives, would let the YoY operating deterioration be attributed. A further quarter of sequential operating-loss narrowing that also turns the YoY comparison favorable would support an upgrade; a reversal of the sequential operating improvement would support a downgrade.

[CHECK] UPST_ADJUSTED_NET_LOSS_YOY=WIDER
